summary: Iteration 5 testing completed for DCLIC Informatique dual-mode layout (PC/iPad). Backend: 36/36 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All dual-mode features working correctly including PC mode sidebar, iPad mode, mode switcher, signature page XL styling, fullscreen kiosk mode with PIN protection.

ui_bugs.issue: PIN dialog closes after showing 'Code PIN incorrect' toast instead of staying open for retry

passed_tests: FRONTEND / (PC): Sidebar visible with all navigation items (Tableau de bord, Clients, Réparations, Commandes client, Encaissement, Journal de caisse)
FRONTEND / (PC): Header with 'Mode: PC' button visible
FRONTEND Mode Switcher: Clicking 'Mode: PC' opens dropdown with 'Mode PC (technicien)' and 'Mode iPad (aperçu)'
FRONTEND Mode Switcher: Selecting 'Mode iPad (aperçu)' redirects to /ipad
FRONTEND /ipad: Light background (slate-50), big text 'DCLIC INFORMATIQUE', no sidebar admin menu
FRONTEND /ipad: Tracking input with 'Code de suivi' placeholder and 'Valider' button
FRONTEND /ipad: 'Passer en mode technicien' link visible at bottom
FRONTEND /ipad: Submitting tracking code redirects to /suivi/{code}
FRONTEND /signer/:id: iPad mode forced (no sidebar), ipad-mode-root visible
FRONTEND /signer/:id: Block order correct - Conditions → Checkbox → Rappel infos → Signature → Valider
FRONTEND /signer/:id: Buttons are 72px height (Effacer and Valider)
FRONTEND /signer/:id: Signature canvas is 320px height
FRONTEND /signer/:id: Text is XL size (H2 = 30px)
FRONTEND /signer/:id: Valider disabled until checkbox checked AND signature drawn
FRONTEND /signer/:id: Already signed state shows 'Déjà signé' badge, signature image, and 'Re-signer' button
FRONTEND /signer/:id?fullscreen=1: 'Activer le plein écran' banner visible in top-right
FRONTEND /signer/:id?fullscreen=1: Invisible kiosk exit zone (opacity: 0) in top-left
FRONTEND /signer/:id?fullscreen=1: Triple-tap on exit zone opens PIN dialog
FRONTEND /signer/:id?fullscreen=1: Wrong PIN (1234) shows 'Code PIN incorrect' toast and stays on page
FRONTEND /signer/:id?fullscreen=1: Correct PIN (4827) redirects to /reparations
FRONTEND /reparations: Lock button (kiosk mode) visible next to 'Faire signer'
FRONTEND Forced iPad mode: /signer/:id shows iPad mode even with localStorage=pc
FRONTEND Forced iPad mode: /suivi/:trackingId shows iPad mode even with localStorage=pc
FRONTEND PC mode preserved: / shows PC mode with sidebar when localStorage=pc
BACKEND: All 36 existing tests pass (100% - no regression)
action_items: OPTIONAL: Keep PIN dialog open after wrong PIN entry for better UX (currently closes and user must triple-tap again)
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dual-mode layout fully implemented and tested: 1) PC mode with full sidebar on /, /clients, /reparations, etc. 2) iPad mode on /ipad, /signer/:id, /suivi/:trackingId with no sidebar. 3) Mode switcher in PC header allows switching to iPad mode. 4) Forced iPad mode on public routes (/signer/*, /suivi/*, /ipad) regardless of localStorage. 5) Signature page has XL styling (72px buttons, 320px canvas, text-xl/2xl). 6) Fullscreen kiosk mode with PIN 4827 protection. 7) Lock button on /reparations opens kiosk mode. Minor UX issue: PIN dialog closes after wrong PIN instead of staying open.
